scope: Posthoc development-only analysis of already frozen R22 raw QPC records. It does not amend R22 quality acceptance, create a coefficient, run simulation, or read target-LLM latency.

timing_boundaries.whole_submit_to_sync_ns: qpc_sync_end - qpc_submit_start; matches the existing direct host formal window
timing_boundaries.outer_nvtx_host_ns: qpc_outer_pop_end - qpc_outer_push_start; retained only to show the negligible wrapper difference

statistics: 30 formal samples per process; p10/p90 use the frozen linear interpolation definition at (n-1)*q.

interpretation.observed_pattern: Across both graph sizes, direct whole-host tails co-occur more strongly with sync-only tails than with submit-only tails. This is an observation of the bounded QPC regions only, not a CPU attribution.
interpretation.direct_submit_profile_perturbation: Profile-vs-direct submit median differences are large, so profiled submit windows cannot substitute for direct-submit calibration.
interpretation.quality_status: Both configurations remain diagnostic_quality_rejected solely because direct whole-host P90/P10 exceeds 1.5; this posthoc split does not retroactively alter that decision.
prohibited: Do not subtract submit or kernel values from whole host to create a CPU constant.
Do not fit any cost coefficient from these statistics.
Do not label sync-only as device time; it contains the observed host call interval around scheduler synchronization.

current.source_rule: physical projection boundaries; quantized M1 FFN fusion only; F32 outputs then SET_ROWS casts

cta_issue.source_rule: physical projection boundaries; quantized M1 FFN fusion only; F32 outputs then SET_ROWS casts

existing_physical_gpu_invocation_ledger.conclusion: Existing llama.cpp.gpu-native-invocations contracts already record source-qualified physical projection boundaries/matrices and separately request MMQ/conversion CTA costs. They explicitly report native_dispatch_proven=false, so they are not a physical CUDA launch-count ledger. Extend this existing contract with dispatch mode/count evidence if needed; do not create a duplicate projection/conversion ledger.
